subtitle.en: One bel leaf offered to Shiva

edition.notes: Eight verses + phalaśruti. Collated from Sanskrit Documents bilvaashhtaka and common temple recension (Green Message / saivism.net class). Line-order of middle verses varies by region.

description.hi: बिल्व पत्र शिव को अर्पण — तीन दल, तीन गुण।
description.en: Offering the three-leaved bel to Shiva.
